'''R2-P3''' was an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] working in an [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]]-run [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], called the [[Vapor Room]], in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. It was equipped with a serving tray, for serving drinks to customers along with the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-Q5/Legends|R2-Q5]]. Sometime before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Galen Marek]] found the blind [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] in the Vapor Room, after searching [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] and other planets. Marek needed his knowledge of fighting the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for his [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]], but [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces found the two Jedi. The droid was caught in the subsequent fight.

==Behind the scenes==
R2-P3 appears in the [[2008]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'' [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|video game]]. R2-P3's name can only be seen after completing the Cloud City level; if the player destroys the droid during the level, it will appear in the enemy list, despite the fact that astromech droids in the game are harmless.
